# Agent Task Radar

> A source-backed directory for discovering high-value Agent tasks.

- Website: https://waynezengcheng-commits.github.io/awesome-agent-task-discovery/
- Repository: https://github.com/waynezengcheng-commits/awesome-agent-task-discovery

## Scope

Each task describes its trigger, Agent execution loop, measurable outcome, and human or safety boundary. P0/P1/P2 and scores prioritize exploration; they do not predict ROI or authorize autonomous high-risk actions.

## Current task categories

- Engineering delivery
- Customer operations
- Risk and security
- Knowledge work
- Revenue growth
- Data operations
- Business operations
